verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.stripe.com and markdown versions of the agentic-commerce docs. The docs give a one-prompt path that points a coding agent at an .md page, Link CLI exposes `--llms-full` for agents, and a machine-readable skills index is live. missing for 10: evidence that the root llms.txt specifically indexes the agentic-commerce section (the probe shows only its general Stripe header).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.stripe.com/llms.txt # Stripe Documentation
PROBE docs-md: HTTP 200 at https://docs.stripe.com/agentic-commerce.md # Agentic commerce
Read https://docs.stripe.com/payments/machine/mpp.md?lang=node, and monetize my API using MPP to charge 0.50 USD per API call
Your agent can inspect the full CLI documentation with `link-cli --llms-full`
https://docs.stripe.com/.well-known/skills/index.json returns the JSON index of Stripe-maintained agent skills
